subsystems.name: Input state source
subsystems.role: produces the noisy non-Clifford states that cultivation refines.
parts: physical non-Clifford operation or lattice-surgery injection

subsystems.name: Cultivation code patch
subsystems.role: a small error-detecting code register that holds and grows the state.

subsystems.name: Syndrome measurement layer
subsystems.role: repeatedly checks the code's stabilisers so errors appear as detection events.

subsystems.name: Post-selection controller
subsystems.role: discards runs showing any detection event and restarts them, instead of correcting.

subsystems.name: Growth engine
subsystems.role: increases the effective code distance round by round to suppress residual errors.

subsystems.name: Output teleportation interface
subsystems.role: delivers the finished state into the main computation as a non-Clifford gate.

buildSteps.title: Fix the noise budget
buildSteps.detail: Classical simulation of the physical error rate determines how many detection rounds are worth running, how big the patch must be, and what acceptance rate to expect.

buildSteps.title: Fabricate the processor
buildSteps.detail: A two-dimensional grid of qubits with tunable couplers and individual readout, of the kind already used for surface-code experiments.

buildSteps.title: Calibrate the Clifford layer
buildSteps.detail: Single-qubit and two-qubit gate fidelities and measurement error are pushed below the level at which detection pays off, verified by randomised benchmarking.

buildSteps.title: Prepare the noisy input
buildSteps.detail: A T state is generated by a physical non-Clifford operation or by lattice-surgery injection, then teleported into the cultivation patch as a raw, error-containing state.

buildSteps.title: Start detection rounds
buildSteps.detail: Stabiliser checks are measured repeatedly and consecutive syndromes compared, so a change in a check flags a fault without it having to be located.

buildSteps.title: Post-select in real time
buildSteps.detail: Any run that shows a detection event is abandoned and restarted; only clean histories survive, and the acceptance rate falls as more rounds are required.

buildSteps.title: Grow the patch
buildSteps.detail: Code deformation expands the patch and raises its distance, so surviving states gain fidelity roughly as a higher power of the physical error rate.

buildSteps.title: Teleport the state out
buildSteps.detail: The patch is measured and the result fed forward to apply a Clifford correction in the main algorithm's logical qubit.

buildSteps.title: Characterise on hardware
buildSteps.detail: Output error and acceptance rate are mapped against physical noise and compared with conventional distillation factories for the same qubit-time cost.

prerequisites.why: two-qubit gate and readout errors around a tenth of a percent have been shown on leading hardware, but they must hold over every round of a cultivation circuit.
demonstrated on small devices, but cultivation needs many rounds in quick succession without degrading neighbouring qubits.

prerequisites.tech: Reliable Clifford gates and gate teleportation
prerequisites.why: cultivation forbids non-Clifford operations, so the whole procedure rests on Clifford operations accurate enough not to dominate the output error.
syndrome comparison and retry decisions must complete within a round time of a few microseconds.
the acceptance-versus-fidelity trade-off of repeated detection without correction is established and well simulated.

pathway.milestone: theory and numerical studies showing far lower qubit-time cost per magic state than distillation factories
pathway.unlocks: a credible route to cheap non-Clifford gates in fault-tolerant runtimes.

pathway.milestone: injection plus a handful of detection rounds on a small code patch in real hardware
pathway.unlocks: measured fidelity boost and acceptance rate to check against simulation.

pathway.milestone: a full cultivation run producing states at algorithm-grade error and consuming them in a small fault-tolerant circuit
pathway.unlocks: an end-to-end demonstration that the non-Clifford bottleneck can be closed this way.

pathway.milestone: cultivation adopted as the magic-state layer in compilers, extended to other resources such as CCZ gates and to alternative codes
pathway.unlocks: smaller, cheaper fault-tolerant machines for the same algorithms.
